text: The major takes monitoring and control technologies, supported by technologies of communications, computers, optoelectronics, and automatic control. It is designed to train professionals with basic knowledge of intelligent instrumentation, computer monitoring and control systems, measurement and control network, the design and manufacturing of precision instruments, communications and information processing, who are capable of measurement and control technology, and the systems design, manufacturing, technology development, applied research, operations management of instrumentation in the field of the national economic departments. The major conforms to the in-depth development of information technology and needs of the large number of talents for control technology and instrumentation. With information technology as the foundation, it focuses on specialties of instrument detection technology and instrumentation, intelligent instrumentation, and network monitoring and control technologies and instrumentation
